findings.rationale: Correct to pin. Folded: G3 starts the child with cwd=$SNAP/repo (the inner run.sh already cds to its own REPO_ROOT derived from $0, i.e. the snapshot) and unsets PWD/OLDPWD; P4 adds a relative tracked-file write fixture.

Folded as honest scope: §1 lists standalone runs and every absolute-path metadata class with its disposition (config=fail, refs/worktrees/working tree=warn, hooks/, info/, objects=unprotected residual). Snapshotting standalone runs is out of scope.
Correct. Folded: after rsync, construction fails closed if any symlink under $SNAP/repo resolves into $REAL_ROOT; P4 fixture with an absolute symlink into the fixture real repo.
Correct. Folded: construction fails closed if $SNAP/repo/.git/objects/info/alternates exists; P4 fixture source repo with alternates.
Correct. Folded: the inventory accepts non-matching emails only from one declared control list in test-identity-guard.test.sh; the rule itself is never restated.

Correct. Folded: a new ref subtracts `--remotes=<pushed remote name>` (pre-push argv $1); unmappable target ⇒ judge `<local_sha> --not --remotes=<name>` falling back to all of `<local_sha>`'s commits not on that remote; P3 two-remote NC.
Correct. Folded: P0 NC — a sandbox without a rogue consumer still passes.
Correct (clone needs an empty destination). Folded: $SNAP is a container `autopilot-test-snapshot.XXXXXX/` holding `.autopilot-live.lock` and `repo/` (the clone target, absent until clone).

Correct. Folded: G5 shutdown sequence — TERM the child process group, wait for it and descendants, then reap worktrees from inside $SNAP/repo, then remove $SNAP; preserve the child exit/signal status; idempotent.
Same as 1cdffdea54, same fold (lock lives in the container, outside rsync --delete scope).
Same as 5bbed9289e for ordering; reaper part folded: when the reaper reclaims a stale container it prunes worktrees from inside repo/ first, scanning the same TMPDIR.
Correct (git config honours env overlays). Folded: G8 reads the bypass with `git config --file <git-path config>` only, and honours it only when the target common dir is under ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}.
Correct (.claude/worktrees/* carry .git files pointing at the real repo). Folded: rsync excludes every nested `.git` (file or dir), not only the top one.
Folded into §1 residual list: snapshot opt-out and rsync-missing in-place runs are covered by G6/warn/KR4/env unset only.
